rendered: Knocking out dacA (a peptidoglycan synthase DacA acting as a negative regulator) altered cell morphology and increased membrane permeability, which facilitated intracellular prodigiosin release and upregulated pigA. The result was a[1][2][3][4] 2.46-fold[5] yield increase over wild-type JNB5–1. The dacA deletion is carried by strain SK4–72.[6]
